operations.title: Set original session optimizer switches

fields.label: Reset all flags to native defaults first
Allow explicit native inspection to change session diagnostics

operations.notes: Fixed request.variable=optimizer_switch. Original-session task mariadb_session_flagsets; inspect/review/set_session_flags on the owner-bound query session. Unlike passive completion, explicit inspection sends native SQL to that session and requires diagnostics_change_confirmed:true for every request. Read native FLAGSET metadata/session value; carry exact string expected_value from review and confirmed:true at apply. Native DEFAULT, FLAGS grid/reset, exact decimal BITMASK and VALUE grammar share global controls. Report expanded native effective_value and partial/unknown outcomes; no commit, rollback, global or future-default change and no reconnect/retry. The selected system-variable resource does not authorize changing another session.

operations.title: Refresh original editor context

fields.label: Allow native inspection to change session diagnostics
fields.help: Explicitly reads the original query session. Its warning and row-count state can change; pending transactions remain owned by the caller.

operations.notes: Task mariadb_editor_context, fixed operation=refresh_completion with diagnostics_change_confirmed:true. Bind the owned public query-session ID and registered target; the server substitutes its private session ID. Returns editor_context with observed original sql_mode/default schema/role/character sets and a same-context private committed catalog. It observes once while the source is idle/locked; it is not a live guarantee after later source commands. Routine declarations remain separate from column types and carry available plus required_sql_mode gates. Temporary objects and uncommitted DDL remain explicitly unobserved. Passive source_complete still sends zero original-session commands. Do not silently call this explicit refresh on keystrokes or replay it after a lost response. Unavailable refresh returns accepted:false, outcome=context_refresh_unavailable, close_session_required and no automatic retry.

operations.description: Issues native SHUTDOWN with native SHUTDOWN authority on a dedicated connection after exact server/service-disruption confirmation.
